reasoning: On the season so far the Trail Blazers are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 11 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 81 times in 100, by about 11; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.
